title: StrategyFacts
description: Layer 0 artifact. Everything the AI planner is allowed to treat as TRUE about a strategy: its node graph (IR), the Semantic Anchor Table (semanticId -> execId + params), and REAL backtest metrics captured from a headless probe run. The planner must narrate only from these facts; it never invents numbers.

anchors.description: The Semantic Anchor Table — output of semanticAnchors(buildFlow()).

metrics.description: Captured from the probe run. Absent until the probe exists; the planner degrades to qualitative narration when missing.
